description: This file defines the EntityFieldManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing entity field definitions, storage, and related metadata, including caching, module hooks, and bundle-specific configurations.

classes.name: EntityFieldManager
classes.description: Manages entity field definitions, storage, and related metadata in Drupal, including caching, module hooks, and bundle-specific configurations.

methods.name: getBaseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves base field definitions for a given entity type, using cache if available.

methods.name: buildBaseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Builds base field definitions for an entity type, including translatable and revision fields, and invokes module hooks.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions for a specific entity type and bundle, merging base and bundle-specific overrides, with caching.

methods.name: buildBundleFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Builds field definitions for a specific bundle, including overrides and module-provided fields.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Returns field storage definitions for an entity type, building and caching if necessary.

methods.name: getActiveFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the active field storage definitions for a content entity type.

methods.name: setFieldMap
methods.description: Sets the internal field map array.

methods.name: getFieldMap
methods.description: Builds and retrieves a map of fields keyed by entity type and field name, with caching.

methods.name: getFieldMapByFieldType
methods.description: Returns a map of fields filtered by field type.

methods.name: buildFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Builds field storage definitions for an entity type, including module hooks.

methods.name: clearCachedFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Clears all cached field definitions and related data.

methods.name: useCaches
methods.description: Enables or disables caching for field definitions.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Retrieves extra fields for an entity type and bundle, loading from cache if needed.

methods.name: loadExtraFields
methods.description: Loads extra fields from cache or rebuilds them by invoking module hooks.

methods.name: preWarm
methods.description: Preloads the field map to optimize performance.

methods.name: getFieldLabels
methods.description: Determines the most common label for a field across bundles.
